reason: A Markdown note manager for capturing conversations, editing workspace notes, referencing them in chat context, and optionally synchronizing them with Git repositories.

summaries.zh: 用于创建、编辑和管理 Markdown 笔记，可将对话内容保存到笔记并在聊天中引用，也支持可选的 Git 同步。
summaries.en: A Markdown note manager for creating, editing, and organizing notes, capturing conversations, referencing notes in chat, and optionally syncing them with Git.

capabilities: Creates, edits, deletes, and reads Markdown note files and metadata within workspace-managed directories
Captures conversation content into selected notes
Injects selected note contents into model context when referenced in chat
Synchronizes note repositories with Git, including pull, push, and deletion mirroring
Provides a browser user interface and local HTTP API for note management
